svg.text: 18 core entities | Selected attributes | Relationships are named inside diamonds | 7 November 2026
Rectangle = entity Oval = attribute Underlined = primary key FK = foreign key 1 and N show maximum cardinality
This conceptual ERD shows 19 main declared relationships. The database design contains all 245 fields and all 34 foreign keys between the 18 core tables.
Optionality and supporting ownership links appear in the database design. A zone is optional; only one configured safe zone and one live-state row are stored per patient.
zone_revision and zone_name in safe_zone_events are historical snapshots. The diagram does not invent a foreign key from those snapshots to the current zone configuration.
